message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. Unlike linear regression, which predicts continuous outcomes, logistic regression models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no). It does this by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features, producing outputs between 0 and 1 that can be interpreted as probabilities. The model parameters are typically estimated using maximum likelihood estimation.
